host.description: BACnet/IP target address. Use 255.255.255.255 for broadcast discovery.

localPort.description: Local UDP port to bind for receiving responses

bindAddress.description: Local network interface to bind (0.0.0.0 for all interfaces)

connectTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for UDP socket bind in milliseconds

readTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for waiting for BACnet responses

deviceId.description: Local BACnet device instance number for identification (0 = auto-assign)

maxApduLength.description: Maximum APDU length accepted in bytes (BACnet standard options)

segmentationSupported.description: Segmentation support advertised to remote devices

foreignDevice.description: Register as a foreign device with a BBMD (BACnet Broadcast Management Device)

connectionSummary: BACnet/IP engine with full BVLC/NPDU/APDU framing. Supports device discovery (Who-Is/I-Am), property read/write (ReadProperty/WriteProperty), bulk reads (ReadPropertyMultiple), and object discovery (Who-Has). Uses UDP port 47808 (0xBAC0) by default.
connectionSteps: Set the target BACnet/IP host and UDP port. The standard port is 47808 (0xBAC0). Use 255.255.255.255 for broadcast discovery.
Choose a local UDP port for bind. The default 47808 is recommended for BACnet/IP compliance.
The engine will bind a UDP socket and be ready to send/receive BACnet/IP frames with proper BVLC framing.
Use invokeCapability 'whoIs' to discover devices on the network, then read/write properties using BACnet address format 'objectType:instance:propertyId'.
readBehavior: Read uses BACnet ReadProperty service. Address format: 'objectType:instance:propertyId' (e.g., '8:1234:85' for Device 1234 present-value). Returns JSON-encoded BACnet application-tagged value.
writeBehavior: Write uses BACnet WriteProperty service. Address format: 'objectType:instance:propertyId'. Data should be a JSON-encoded BacnetValue with tag and value fields (e.g., '{"tag":91,"value":1}' for enumerated).

whoIs.description: Discover BACnet devices on the network. Returns array of BacnetDevice objects.

readProperty.description: Read a single BACnet property. Returns BacnetValue.

readPropertyMultiple.description: Read multiple BACnet properties in one request. Returns array of BacnetValue.

propertyIds.description: Array of property IDs to read

whoHas.description: Discover objects by name or instance. Returns array of I-Have responses.
